notes.title: Players Entejty and corporatezombie enjoy a fierce competition of massive high scores!
notes.notes:
Entejty must have felt he would have the top spot of the Cloudrift Galactic High Score Table for quite a while, having scored 13,708,656! But unfortunately for him, just a few hours later, the previous champion corporatezombie saw the news, strapped on his Rift, and scored 36,697,569!

It's great to see people understanding Cloudrift strategy so well, check out this discussion between these 2 current Champions, and don't miss the linked guide that corporatezombie has written!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/403270/discussions/0/352788917758518179/

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=723634783

notes.title: Player "corporatezombie" CONQUERS Cloudrift, writes extremely insightful guide!
notes.notes:
Not content with edging to the top of the Cloudrift Galactic High Score Table, corporatezombie has subsequently posted an amazing score of 7,326,862! This is unknown territory and is tempting me, the developer, to start posting my own scores to see if I can beat it :)

This skilled Cloudrifter also decided to share his extremely useful insights into how to play Cloudrift successfully - he's unlocked a few of the main secrets for high scoring. Check it out here! http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=723634783

notes.title: Fellow European corporatezombie edges ahead in the Cloudrift Galactic High Score Table!
notes.notes:
Just 1 month after jellosnax scored 2,155,024 points, corporatezombie has practised with a trackball, struggled a little to get his gamepad to work, then shown us all how to play, collecting 204,605 more points and posting 2,359,629 as the new Galactic High Score!

Well done corporatezombie, it's great to hear you're enjoying Cloudrift :)

notes.title: Cloudrift - now with added dimensions!
notes.notes:
Cloudrift was designed from the ground up to be a unique and interesting game both on the desktop [b]and[/b] in ViRtUaL rEaLiTy! Full support for all ViRtUaL rEaLiTy systems is now built in, so if you already own Cloudrift and have been lucky enough to get your hands on a Rift or Vive, check it out right now! It's an exciting experience to be right there above the cloud, and you might even find you can more accurately judge those peak hops!

If you haven't yet taken a look at Cloudrift, now is the perfect time to see how far you can climb up the Galactic High Score Table in this highly rated arcade challenge!

The ViRtUaL rEaLiTy version of Cloudrift is single player only, but you can still enjoy local multiplayer when playing on the desktop!

notes.title: Magni takes the lead of the Cloudrift Single Player Galactic High Score Table!
notes.notes:
Congratulations to Magni who has started 2016 in style by beating CONTRA 2634AD's previous galactic record by a big margin! 1,844,266 is now the score to beat. So far every challenger has been Earth based - if you're from elsewhere, don't forget that this is a galactic challenge, so even [i]you[/i] are eligible to partake!

Magni's high score is getting close to the developer's best so won't be easy to beat, but with practice and patience everyone has a chance!

notes.title: We have a new Galactic High Score leader!
notes.notes:
After 2 weeks, CONTRA 2634AD has managed to better Miro Sato to take first place on the Cloudrift Single Player Galactic High Score Table, with a very respectable 1,013,818!

Well done Contra, it will be interesting to see how long you keep the top spot!
